# Karnata.in — Universe of Karnataka (Live Civic, Market, Weather & Journalism Portal)

> Karnata.in is Karnataka's independent Kannada-first live public data, utility, and investigative journalism portal covering all 31 districts of Karnataka, India.

## Live Real-Time Telemetry & Daily Rates
- **Karnataka Live Weather & 31-District IMD Warnings Map**: https://karnata.in/weather — Official IMD 3-hour Nowcast, 5-day district forecast alerts (Red/Orange/Yellow/Green), KSNDMC Top-5 rainfall & temperature extremes, live AQI, Sunrise/Sunset solar arc, GPS hyper-local weather, and 27 Male Nakshatragalu (Rain Nakshatras).
- **Karnataka Gold & Silver Rate Today**: https://karnata.in/gold-rate — Daily 24K, 22K, 18K Gold (Jos Alukkas Karnataka live + 365-day & 125-year history), Live Bangalore Silver 999 & 2015–2026 historical chart (Dhan.co), Jewellery Bill Calculator, and Old Gold Exchange Calculator.
- **Karnataka Petrol & Diesel Prices (31 Districts)**: https://karnata.in/petrol-price — Daily 6:00 AM IST live Petrol, Diesel, and CNG rates across all 31 districts and 190+ taluks of Karnataka.
- **Karnataka APMC Mandi Prices (KRAMA Live)**: https://karnata.in/apmc-prices — Daily modal, minimum, and maximum quintal prices across 170+ Karnataka APMC mandis (Byadgi chilli, Shivamogga/Sirsi arecanut, Kolar tomato, Hubballi cotton/onion).
- **Karnataka Dam Water Levels (13 Major Reservoirs)**: https://karnata.in/dam-levels — Live TMC storage, percentage full, inflow & outflow cusecs for KRS, Almatti, Kabini, Hemavathi, Harangi, Tungabhadra, Bhadra, Linganamakki, Supa, Ghataprabha, Malaprabha, Narayanapura, and Vanivilasa Sagar.

- **Financial & Kannada Tools**: https://karnata.in/emi-calculator , https://karnata.in/sip-calculator , https://karnata.in/salary-calculator , https://karnata.in/kannada-typing
